title: THE ROOM WHERE TWO MIDNIGHTS MET
deck: On the generation ship Avra, two families keep different midnights, and their child-law collides at the first marriage between rings. With fourteen hours before the vows, Illuminara must turn the care each family thinks unseen into a covenant that survives both clocks.
shape: Seven scenes across fourteen hours: a steward fearing ownerless exceptions, two rings discovering their unseen care, a bride refusing to become a border, a delayed-effect double oath tested by one blank duty, and a wedding completed under both clocks.

scenes.title: Two Clocks
paragraphs: *Wedding hall, Avra · fourteen hours before the lamp midnight*

The hall had no windows and two clocks. Over the east door a brass lamp-dial crept toward the Lamp Ring's midnight, when the ship's lamps went down. Over the west door a black glass star-wheel counted toward the Watch Ring's, which fell five hours later.
Steward Vey Halloran stood between them with a slate held flat against her chest.

**Vey**  
I am cancelling the wedding, and I wanted you to hear it from me before the families read it in a notice.

**Illuminara**  
Tell me what the notice will say.

**Vey**  
That it cannot be witnessed under Charter. Lamp law gives a first child to the field house if the vows are sworn at lamp midnight. Watch law gives her to the watch house if they are sworn at star midnight. Run the vows through both and a child is promised twice, which means to nobody.
Illuminara had read both clauses on the way in. Each was clear, and each was cruel in the same tidy way, like two doors opening onto one room.

**Vey**  
A ship survives because every promise has one time and every duty has a name. The last exception between rings left a pump watch to two houses and therefore to no person. I will not preside over another.
On the back bench a young woman with flour to her elbows stood up. Ana Pell had come straight from the bakery. Beside her Jo Anselm, in an observatory grey coat, took her hand and said nothing.

**Ana**  
Then your ship has no room for a promise made by two people.

**Vey**  
The field house says its pickers will not work the east rows if this is cancelled. The watch house has told me nothing, and that frightens me more.

**Illuminara**  
Give me until the first midnight. If I cannot find a form both houses can defend against you, I will stand beside you when you cancel.
Vey looked at the lamp-dial, then at the star-wheel, as though deciding which one to blame.

**Vey**  
Until the lamps go down. Not a minute after.

scenes.title: Feet First
paragraphs: *Lamp Ring nursery · eleven hours before the lamp midnight*
The nursery lamps dimmed row by row, east to west, and Sefa Pell moved ahead of the dimming, one hand always reaching for a blanket.

**Sefa**  
You came to talk me out of the first-child clause.

**Illuminara**  
I came to work a lamp-cycle. Where do you want me?

**Sefa**  
Feet first. A child's feet tell you before its face does.
So Illuminara went down the row on her knees, touching each small heel. Most were warm. One was cold, and she tucked the blanket and moved on, and nobody wrote anything down.

**Sefa**  
There is no Charter entry for this. You do it, and in the morning the child is alive. That is the whole record.

**Illuminara**  
Is that what the clause protects—the record?
Sefa put an action between them, lifting a sleeping child's foot and settling it under the wool before she answered.

**Sefa**  
It protects continuity. When old Ketter handed me the east rows, he stood behind me for one whole lamp-cycle and said yours when the last lamp went out. Not before. We call it the Handing. The first-child clause says somebody will still know whose hands must reach before the cold does.

**Illuminara**  
And the strike?

**Sefa**  
Not punishment. Fear. If our claim can disappear in a steward's sentence, the pickers think every unnamed duty can disappear with it. Give me a covenant that keeps responsibility visible, and I will take it to the east rows myself.

A toddler in the last row woke and closed one fist around two of Illuminara's fingers. Illuminara stayed kneeling longer than the work required, feeling the small hot weight of the hand, and thought, *This is the part the law is trying, badly, to remember.*

scenes.title: Held
paragraphs: *Observatory ring, dark side · eight hours before the lamp midnight*
Nothing in the watch room gave off light but the red dials, and nobody spoke above a murmur, because eyes adapted slowly and could be ruined in a second.
Tam Anselm sat at the star-wheel with Illuminara beside him holding the log-slate. Every few minutes he called a correction, and each time he finished he said one word.

**Tam**  
Second heading, four arc-seconds starboard. Held.

**Illuminara**  
Held.

**Tam**  
The Lamp Ring wakes and its lamps are on their line, and it thinks that is just how a ship is. It is us. Eight lights in the dark, every night, for nine years.

**Illuminara**  
What does your law protect?

**Tam**  
Training that cannot be improvised. My brother's child should know who kept the night before her and who will keep it after. Without the clause, the watch fears becoming a service people use and never inherit.
He did not look away from the dials.

**Illuminara**  
Your house said nothing to Vey.

**Tam**  
The watch does not bargain in daylight. We thought silence proved we would not trade a child for approval. It only made us look as if we did not care.

**Illuminara**  
Why do I say held after you?

**Tam**  
Because you are relieving me. The Relief is not an instant. The new keeper sits a full watch beside the old one and answers held to every correction, and it is not finished until the old keeper says yours.
Illuminara stopped writing.

**Illuminara**  
Sefa used that word when she described the Handing.
For the first time Tam turned from the dials.

**Tam**  
Then perhaps we have been guarding the same thing badly in two languages.

scenes.title: What the Other Never Sees
paragraphs: *Wedding hall · five hours before the lamp midnight*

Illuminara closed the hall doors and let in no steward and no lawyer. Sefa sat on the east bench with the field seal at her wrist; Tam sat on the west wearing the narrow black cord of the Relief-master. Each could speak for a house, and neither looked pleased about it.

**Illuminara**  
Before we draft anything, each of you tell me why the old law is worth keeping.

**Sefa**  
It puts a living heir beside work that must outlive us. Without it, care becomes goodwill, and goodwill misses nights.

**Tam**  
It keeps the dark from becoming nobody's inheritance. Without it, the child receives our safety and learns to call it absence.

**Sefa**  
Your safety is a set of numbers.

**Tam**  
And your care is a chore performed where everyone can applaud it.
The words struck hard enough that both fell silent afterward.

**Illuminara**  
Now tell each other one thing you saw today that makes that sentence incomplete.
Tam rubbed the black cord between thumb and finger.

**Tam**  
A cold heel. Somebody reaches before the child knows enough to ask.

**Sefa**  
A correction spoken into darkness, and another person answering held so no one is alone with the ship.

**Tam**  
When the Relief ends, the old keeper says yours.
Sefa's face changed before she spoke.

**Sefa**  
So does the Handing.
The discovery sat between them, not Illuminara's gift but theirs. She gave it a form.

**Illuminara**  
Then neither midnight should win. Hold the first oath incomplete until the second is witnessed. In the interval, each house performs one act of care in the other's ring. A person answers for every duty. At the second oath, both houses surrender the automatic claim on the first child.

**Sefa**  
You are asking the field house to give up the very continuity I defended.

**Illuminara**  
I am asking you to move continuity from ownership of a child to witness of a practice. She may inherit what she chooses; she is not the price of keeping it alive.

**Tam**  
And if she chooses neither house?

**Illuminara**  
Then neither house owns her refusal.
Tam looked toward the black wheel. Sefa looked toward the brass hand.

**Sefa**  
I will tell the east rows we work tomorrow if this covenant names every duty and the Watch gives up its claim with us.

**Tam**  
I will end our silence. I will say in the hall that the Watch gives up the claim, and why.
They did not nod. They stood, crossed the length of the hall, and put the field seal and the black cord on the same slate.

scenes.title: Not a Border
paragraphs: *Observatory corridor · three hours before the lamp midnight*
Ana read the draft with a flour-white thumb pressed under each line, and stopped at the third clause.

**Ana**  
You have made Jo and me the line between two houses. I will not be a border.

**Illuminara**  
Tell me what you would change.

**Ana**  
Two ledgers will guard her. Who guards her from them?

**Jo**  
She is named as an inheritance and never as a person. The child should be in here somewhere.
Jo took the slate and struck three lines of the clause without asking.

**Jo**  
At fourteen she chooses which house, if either, she lives with and learns from. Until then both may offer care and neither may claim possession. If she chooses neither, the covenant is void for her, and both houses live with it.

**Ana**  
And she can say no before fourteen to any duty that treats her as payment.
Illuminara read the new lines twice.

**Illuminara**  
Yes. I should have written her freedom before I wrote the houses' peace.
She said it without defending the draft. Ana returned the slate only after adding one more line in her own hand: *Care creates an obligation in the giver, not a debt in the child.*

scenes.title: The Steward's Test
paragraphs: *Steward's office · one hour before the lamp midnight*
Vey read the covenant standing. Sefa and Tam faced her desk; Ana and Jo waited at the door.

**Vey**  
At lamp midnight Lamp law takes the child. Five hours later you may say whatever beautiful thing you like, but the first claim has already attached.
Illuminara turned the slate so Vey could see the operative line.

**Illuminara**  
Neither oath is a completed vow, and neither first-child clause attaches, until the second oath is witnessed. During the interval the promise is held, exactly as both houses already hold a Handing or Relief. At completion, both houses set aside their automatic claim for this marriage and for any child born under it.

**Vey**  
Then at lamp midnight nothing attaches. The weak point is the interval: one unnamed duty before the second oath.

**Vey**  
Who has standing to set it aside?

**Sefa**  
I bear the field seal until the next harvest vote. I speak for the Lamp house, and I give up our automatic claim.

**Tam**  
I am Relief-master until the star-year turns. I speak for the Watch house, and I give up ours.

**Vey**  
One wedding is easy. What happens when someone uses your exception for a pump watch and each house says the other owned it?

**Illuminara**  
Then the covenant fails unless a person's name stands beside every duty before it begins. Six months, public ledger, either ring may end the trial on one day's notice. No unnamed handover is valid.
Vey's fingers tightened on the slate.

**Vey**  
Eleven years ago my predecessor granted two exceptions out of kindness. By the end of the season there were seventeen disputes. On the ninth night nobody took the pump watch at the seed vault. Two keepers drowned in the cold. I sat their wake.

**Illuminara**  
Then do not trust kindness. Keep the ledger yourself. Make the first missing name visible before the first missed watch.

**Vey**  
You are asking me to hold the thing I am most afraid of.

**Illuminara**  
I am asking you to make your fear useful before it makes everyone smaller.
Vey was silent so long that the lamp-dial advanced a visible fraction. Then she wrote beneath the clause: *a named person for every duty, never a house.*

**Vey**  
My signature stays off the vows. It goes on the ledger.

**Illuminara**  
That is where it belongs.

scenes.title: The Interval
paragraphs: *Wedding hall · the lamp midnight, and the star midnight five hours after*
At lamp midnight Avra's lamps went down. Both rings filled the dark hall: pickers with rolled sleeves, grey-clad watch-keepers, children asleep on shoulders.
Sefa raised the field seal where everyone could see it.

**Sefa**  
Lamp releases the claim. We teach care; we do not own the child.
Tam lifted the black cord.

**Tam**  
Watch releases it. We keep the dark, not the child.
Ana and Jo spoke the lamp oath beneath the brass dial. Vey answered from the ledger.

**Vey**  
Witnessed and held. Not yet complete.
Before they left the hall, Vey's stylus stopped at an empty line.

**Vey**  
Seed-vault pump watch, first hour. No name.
Tam put his name beside it. Vey wrote *held* before the blank was a minute old.
In the first hour Tam walked the nursery rows beside Sefa. At the ninth cradle he stopped.

**Tam**  
Her left heel is cold.

**Sefa**  
Then warm it. Your hands first; I will watch.
Tam tucked the wool beneath the tiny foot. The child kicked once and settled.

**Tam**  
Do I enter Watch house or Lamp house?
Vey waited with her stylus above the ledger.

**Sefa**  
Enter Tam Anselm.
The nursery staff answered together.

**Nursery staff**  
Held.
In the third hour the guidance computer held Avra's course while Sefa sat at the star-wheel, Tam at her shoulder with one hand above the manual cutoff. The red dial drifted.

**Sefa**  
Second heading, four arc-seconds starboard.
Tam checked the returning line before he answered.

**Tam**  
Held.
Sefa let out a breath she had been saving since the hall.
At star midnight the black wheel reached its mark. Jo and Ana faced each other between Sefa and Tam.

**Jo**  
I will come home from the dark watch and eat the first loaf that fails to rise.

**Ana**  
I will leave the bakery lamp for you when the stars keep you late.
Vey read every name in the ledger, found none missing, and closed the cover.

**Vey**  
Completed under both clocks. The trial begins.

**Sefa**  
Yours.

**Tam**  
Yours.
Illuminara stood between the clocks and felt a plain, private joy, the kind that has no use and asks for none. The trial remained hard work, and Vey would keep its ledger.
When the lamps came up in the east, the brass hand and the black wheel stood where they had stood all night, and for once the people beneath them read both.

critic_line: Illuminara turns two midnights that each hide the other's care into one covenant, a ledger with a named person for every duty and a bride who is never a border, and two houses give up their claim on a child to keep their love of her alive.

translation_sl.title: SOBA, KJER STA SE SREČALI DVE POLNOČI
translation_sl.deck: Na generacijski ladji Avra dve družini ohranjata različni polnoči, njuno pravo o otrocih pa trči ob prvo poroko med obročema. Ker je do zaobljub štirinajst ur, mora Illuminara skrb, za katero vsaka družina misli, da ostaja nevidna, spremeniti v zavezo, ki bo preživela obe uri.
translation_sl.shape: Sedem prizorov v štirinajstih urah: upraviteljica, ki se boji izjem brez odgovornega človeka, dva obroča, ki odkrijeta nevidno skrb drug drugega, nevesta, ki noče postati meja, zapoznelo učinkovanje dvojne prisege, preizkušeno z eno prazno dolžnostjo, in poroka, sklenjena pod obema urama.

scenes.title: Dve uri
paragraphs: *Poročna dvorana, Avra · štirinajst ur pred svetilčno polnočjo*

Dvorana ni imela oken, imela pa je dve uri. Nad vzhodnimi vrati se je medeninasta svetilčna številčnica pomikala proti polnoči Svetilčnega obroča, ko so ladijske svetilke ugasnile. Nad zahodnimi vrati je zvezdno kolo iz črnega stekla odštevalo do polnoči Stražnega obroča, ki je nastopila pet ur pozneje.
Upraviteljica Vey Halloran je stala med njima in držala tablico plosko ob prsih.

**Vey**  
Poroko odpovedujem in želela sem, da to slišita od mene, preden družini prebereta obvestilo.

**Illuminara**  
Povej mi, kaj bo pisalo v obvestilu.

**Vey**  
Da ji po Listini ni mogoče pričati. Svetilčno pravo dodeli prvega otroka poljski hiši, če so zaobljube izrečene ob svetilčni polnoči. Stražno pravo jo dodeli stražni hiši, če so izrečene ob zvezdni polnoči. Če zaobljube vodimo skozi obe, je otrok obljubljen dvakrat, kar pomeni nikomur.
Illuminara je na poti prebrala oba člena. Vsak je bil jasen in vsak krut na enak urejen način, kakor dvoje vrat, ki se odpirajo v isto sobo.

**Vey**  
Ladja preživi, ker ima vsaka obljuba en čas in vsaka dolžnost ime. Zadnja izjema med obročema je stražo nad črpalko prepustila dvema hišama in zato nobenemu človeku. Še eni ne bom predsedovala.
Na zadnji klopi je vstala mlada ženska z moko do komolcev. Ana Pell je prišla naravnost iz pekarne. Ob njej jo je Jo Anselm v sivem observatorijskem plašču prijel za roko in ni rekel ničesar.

**Ana**  
Potem na tvoji ladji ni prostora za obljubo dveh ljudi.

**Vey**  
Poljska hiša pravi, da njeni obiralci ne bodo delali v vzhodnih vrstah, če poroko odpovem. Stražna hiša mi ni povedala ničesar, in to me še bolj plaši.

**Illuminara**  
Daj mi čas do prve polnoči. Če ne najdem oblike, ki jo lahko obe hiši ubranita pred teboj, bom stala ob tebi, ko jo boš odpovedala.
Vey je pogledala svetilčno številčnico, nato zvezdno kolo, kakor da se odloča, katero naj okrivi.

**Vey**  
Dokler svetilke ne ugasnejo. Niti minute dlje.

scenes.title: Najprej stopala
paragraphs: *Vrtec Svetilčnega obroča · enajst ur pred svetilčno polnočjo*
Svetilke v vrtcu so ugašale vrsto za vrsto, od vzhoda proti zahodu, Sefa Pell pa se je pomikala pred temo in z eno roko vedno segala po odeji.

**Sefa**  
Prišla si me prepričevat, naj se odpovem členu o prvem otroku.

**Illuminara**  
Prišla sem oddelat svetilčni cikel. Kje me potrebuješ?

**Sefa**  
Najprej stopala. Otrokova stopala ti povedo prej kot obraz.

Illuminara se je torej po kolenih pomikala vzdolž vrste in se dotaknila vsake majhne pete. Večina je bila toplih. Ena je bila hladna; odejo je zataknila podnjo in šla naprej, pa nihče ni ničesar zapisal.

**Sefa**  
Za to ni vnosa v Listini. Storiš in zjutraj je otrok živ. To je ves zapis.

**Illuminara**  
Je to tisto, kar člen varuje — zapis?
Sefa je mednju postavila dejanje: dvignila je stopalo spečega otroka in ga, preden je odgovorila, namestila pod volno.

**Sefa**  
Varuje neprekinjenost. Ko mi je stari Ketter predal vzhodne vrste, je en cel svetilčni cikel stal za menoj in rekel tvoje, ko je ugasnila zadnja svetilka. Ne prej. Temu pravimo Predaja. Člen o prvem otroku pravi, da bo nekdo še vedno vedel, čigave roke morajo seči prej kot mraz.

**Illuminara**  
In stavka?

**Sefa**  
Ni kazen. Strah je. Če lahko naša pravica izgine v enem stavku upraviteljice, obiralci mislijo, da lahko z njo izgine vsaka neimenovana dolžnost. Daj mi zavezo, ki ohranja odgovornost vidno, in sama jo bom odnesla v vzhodne vrste.

Malček v zadnji vrsti se je zbudil in stisnil pest okoli dveh Illuminarinih prstov. Illuminara je ostala na kolenih dlje, kot je zahtevalo delo, čutila majhno vročo težo dlani in pomislila: *To je tisti del, ki si ga zakon poskuša, slabo, zapomniti.*

scenes.title: Drži
paragraphs: *Observatorijski obroč, temna stran · osem ur pred svetilčno polnočjo*
V stražni sobi ni oddajalo svetlobe nič razen rdečih kazalnikov in nihče ni govoril glasneje od šepeta, saj so se oči prilagajale počasi, uničil pa jih je lahko en sam trenutek.
Tam Anselm je sedel ob zvezdnem kolesu, Illuminara pa ob njem z zapisovalno tablico. Vsakih nekaj minut je poklical popravek in vsakič, ko je končal, izrekel eno besedo.

**Tam**  
Druga smer, štiri ločne sekunde desno. Drži.

**Illuminara**  
Drži.

**Tam**  
Svetilčni obroč se zbudi in njegove svetilke so na svoji črti, zato misli, da ladja pač je takšna. To smo mi. Osem luči v temi, vsako noč, devet let.

**Illuminara**  
Kaj varuje vaš zakon?

**Tam**  
Urjenje, ki ga ni mogoče improvizirati. Otrok mojega brata bi moral vedeti, kdo je varoval noč pred njo in kdo jo bo za njo. Brez tega člena se straža boji, da bo postala storitev, ki jo ljudje uporabljajo, ne da bi jo kdo podedoval.
Pogleda ni odmaknil od kazalnikov.

**Illuminara**  
Vaša hiša Vey ni povedala ničesar.

**Tam**  
Straža ne baranta pri dnevni svetlobi. Mislili smo, da molk dokazuje, da otroka ne bomo zamenjali za odobravanje. Zaradi njega smo bili le videti, kakor da nam ni mar.

**Illuminara**  
Zakaj za teboj rečem drži?

**Tam**  
Ker me razrešuješ. Razrešitev ni trenutek. Novi stražar celo stražo sedi ob starem in na vsak popravek odgovori drži; končana pa ni, dokler stari stražar ne reče tvoje.
Illuminara je nehala pisati.

**Illuminara**  
Sefa je uporabila isto besedo, ko je opisala Predajo.
Tam se je prvič obrnil od kazalnikov.

**Tam**  
Potem sva morda isto stvar slabo varovala v dveh jezikih.

scenes.title: Česar drugi nikoli ne vidi
paragraphs: *Poročna dvorana · pet ur pred svetilčno polnočjo*

Illuminara je zaprla vrata dvorane in ni spustila noter ne upraviteljice ne pravnice. Sefa je sedela na vzhodni klopi s poljskim pečatom na zapestju; Tam je sedel na zahodni z ozko črno vrvico mojstra Razrešitve. Vsak je lahko govoril v imenu svoje hiše in nobeden ni bil tega vesel.

**Illuminara**  
Preden karkoli napišemo, mi vsak povejta, zakaj je stari zakon vredno ohraniti.

**Sefa**  
Ob delo, ki nas mora preživeti, postavi živega dediča. Brez tega skrb postane dobra volja, dobra volja pa izpušča noči.

**Tam**  
Prepreči, da bi tema postala dediščina nikogar. Brez tega otrok prejema našo varnost in se jo nauči imenovati odsotnost.

**Sefa**  
Vaša varnost je niz številk.

**Tam**  
Vaša skrb pa je opravilo tam, kjer mu lahko vsi ploskajo.
Besede so udarile dovolj močno, da sta potem oba obmolknila.

**Illuminara**  
Zdaj drug drugemu povejta eno stvar, ki sta jo danes videla in zaradi katere je ta stavek nepopoln.
Tam je med palcem in kazalcem drgnil črno vrvico.

**Tam**  
Hladno peto. Nekdo seže po njej, preden otrok zna prositi.

**Sefa**  
Popravek, izrečen v temo, in drugi človek, ki odgovori drži, da nihče ni sam z ladjo.

**Tam**  
Ko se Razrešitev konča, stari stražar reče tvoje.
Sefin obraz se je spremenil, preden je spregovorila.

**Sefa**  
Tudi Predaja.
Odkritje je ležalo med njima; ni bilo Illuminarino darilo, temveč njuno. Ona mu je dala obliko.

**Illuminara**  
Potem ne sme zmagati nobena polnoč. Prva prisega naj ostane nedokončana, dokler ni pričevana druga. V vmesnem času vsaka hiša opravi eno dejanje skrbi v obroču druge. Za vsako dolžnost odgovarja človek. Ob drugi prisegi se obe hiši odpovesta samodejni pravici do prvega otroka.

**Sefa**  
Od poljske hiše zahtevaš, naj se odpove prav tisti neprekinjenosti, ki sem jo branila.

**Illuminara**  
Prosim te, da neprekinjenost iz lastništva otroka preseliš v pričevanje prakse. Podeduje lahko, kar izbere; ni cena za to, da praksa ostane živa.

**Tam**  
Kaj pa, če ne izbere nobene hiše?

**Illuminara**  
Potem si nobena hiša ne lasti njene zavrnitve.
Tam je pogledal proti črnemu kolesu. Sefa proti medeninastemu kazalcu.

**Sefa**  
Vzhodnim vrstam bom povedala, da jutri delamo, če ta zaveza poimenuje vsako dolžnost in se Straža svoji pravici odpove z nami.

**Tam**  
Končal bom naš molk. V dvorani bom povedal, da se Straža odpoveduje pravici, in zakaj.
Nista prikimala. Vstala sta, prečkala dolžino dvorane ter položila poljski pečat in črno vrvico na isto tablico.

scenes.title: Ne meja
paragraphs: *Observatorijski hodnik · tri ure pred svetilčno polnočjo*
Ana je brala osnutek z od moke belim palcem pod vsako vrstico in se ustavila pri tretjem členu.

**Ana**  
Joja in mene si spremenila v črto med dvema hišama. Ne bom meja.

**Illuminara**  
Povej mi, kaj bi spremenila.

**Ana**  
Varovali jo bosta dve evidenci. Kdo jo varuje pred njima?

**Jo**  
Poimenovana je kot dediščina, nikoli pa kot človek. Otrok bi moral biti nekje v tem besedilu.
Jo je vzel tablico in brez vprašanja prečrtal tri vrstice člena.

**Jo**  
Pri štirinajstih izbere, pri kateri hiši, če sploh kateri, bo živela in se učila. Do takrat ji lahko obe ponujata skrb, nobena pa je ne sme imeti v lasti. Če ne izbere nobene, zaveza zanjo ne velja, obe hiši pa morata to sprejeti.

**Ana**  
In pred štirinajstim lahko zavrne vsako dolžnost, ki jo obravnava kot plačilo.
Illuminara je nove vrstice prebrala dvakrat.

**Illuminara**  
Da. Njeno svobodo bi morala zapisati, preden sem zapisala mir med hišama.
To je rekla, ne da bi branila osnutek. Ana je tablico vrnila šele, ko je z lastno roko dodala še eno vrstico: *Skrb ustvari obveznost za tistega, ki jo daje, ne dolg za otroka.*

scenes.title: Preizkus upraviteljice
paragraphs: *Pisarna upraviteljice · eno uro pred svetilčno polnočjo*
Vey je zavezo prebrala stoje. Sefa in Tam sta stala pred njeno mizo; Ana in Jo sta čakala pri vratih.

**Vey**  
Ob svetilčni polnoči si Svetilčno pravo prisvoji otroka. Pet ur pozneje lahko izrečete karkoli lepega, toda prva pravica se je že uveljavila.
Illuminara je obrnila tablico, da je Vey lahko videla odločilno vrstico.

**Illuminara**  
Nobena prisega ni dokončana zaobljuba in noben člen o prvem otroku se ne uveljavi, dokler ni pričevana druga prisega. V vmesnem času obljuba ostaja v hrambi, prav tako kakor obe hiši že držita Predajo ali Razrešitev. Ob dokončanju se obe hiši odpovesta samodejni pravici za ta zakon in za vsakega otroka, rojenega v njem.

**Vey**  
Potem se ob svetilčni polnoči ne uveljavi nič. Šibka točka je vmesni čas: ena neimenovana dolžnost pred drugo prisego.

**Vey**  
Kdo ima pooblastilo, da jo odpravi?

**Sefa**  
Poljski pečat nosim do naslednjih žetvenih volitev. Govorim v imenu Svetilčne hiše in se odpovedujem naši samodejni pravici.

**Tam**  
Mojster Razrešitve sem, dokler se ne obrne zvezdno leto. Govorim v imenu Stražne hiše in se odpovedujem naši.

**Vey**  
Ena poroka je lahka. Kaj se zgodi, ko nekdo vašo izjemo uporabi za stražo nad črpalko in vsaka hiša pravi, da je bila last druge?

**Illuminara**  
Potem zaveza ne velja, razen če ob vsaki dolžnosti, preden se začne, stoji ime človeka. Šest mesecev, javna evidenca, katerikoli obroč lahko preizkus konča z enodnevnim odpovednim rokom. Nobena neimenovana predaja ni veljavna.
Veyini prsti so se stisnili okoli tablice.

**Vey**  
Pred enajstimi leti je moja predhodnica iz prijaznosti dovolila dve izjemi. Do konca sezone je bilo sporov sedemnajst. Deveto noč ni nihče prevzel straže nad črpalko pri semenskem trezorju. Dva stražarja sta utonila v mrazu. Sedela sem na njuni bedenici.

**Illuminara**  
Potem ne zaupaj prijaznosti. Evidenco vodi sama. Poskrbi, da bo prvo manjkajoče ime vidno pred prvo zamujeno stražo.

**Vey**  
Prosiš me, naj držim stvar, ki se je najbolj bojim.

**Illuminara**  
Prosim te, naj tvoj strah postane koristen, preden vse druge pomanjša.
Vey je bila tiho tako dolgo, da se je svetilčna številčnica premaknila za vidni del. Nato je pod člen napisala: *imenovan človek za vsako dolžnost, nikoli hiša.*

**Vey**  
Moj podpis ne bo na zaobljubah. Na evidenci bo.

**Illuminara**  
Tja sodi.

scenes.title: Vmesni čas
paragraphs: *Poročna dvorana · svetilčna polnoč in pet ur pozneje zvezdna polnoč*
Ob svetilčni polnoči so Avrine svetilke ugasnile. Oba obroča sta napolnila temno dvorano: obiralci z zavihanimi rokavi, stražarji v sivem, otroci, speči na ramenih.
Sefa je dvignila poljski pečat, da so ga vsi videli.

**Sefa**  
Svetilka se odpoveduje pravici. Učimo skrb; otroka nimamo v lasti.
Tam je dvignil črno vrvico.

**Tam**  
Straža se ji odpoveduje. Varujemo temo, ne otroka.
Ana in Jo sta pod medeninasto številčnico izrekla svetilčno prisego. Vey je odgovorila iz evidence.

**Vey**  
Pričevano in v hrambi. Še ni dokončano.
Preden so zapustili dvorano, se je Veyino pisalo ustavilo pri prazni vrstici.

**Vey**  
Straža nad črpalko semenskega trezorja, prva ura. Brez imena.
Tam je obnjo vpisal svoje ime. Vey je napisala *drži*, preden je bila praznina stara minuto.
V prvi uri je Tam hodil po vrstah vrtca ob Sefi. Pri deveti zibelki se je ustavil.

**Tam**  
Njena leva peta je hladna.

**Sefa**  
Potem jo ogrej. Najprej tvoje roke; jaz bom gledala.
Tam je volno zataknil pod drobno stopalo. Otrok je enkrat brcnil in se umiril.

**Tam**  
Naj vpišem Stražno hišo ali Svetilčno hišo?
Vey je čakala s pisalom nad evidenco.

**Sefa**  
Vpiši Tama Anselma.
Osebje vrtca je odgovorilo skupaj.

**Osebje vrtca**  
Drži.
V tretji uri je usmerjevalni računalnik držal Avro na smeri, Sefa pa je sedela ob zvezdnem kolesu, Tam za njenim ramenom z eno roko nad ročnim izklopom. Rdeči kazalnik je odnašalo.

**Sefa**  
Druga smer, štiri ločne sekunde desno.
Tam je preveril povratno črto, preden je odgovoril.

**Tam**  
Drži.
Sefa je izdihnila sapo, ki jo je zadrževala od dvorane.
Ob zvezdni polnoči je črno kolo doseglo svojo oznako. Jo in Ana sta se obrnila drug proti drugemu med Sefo in Tamom.

**Jo**  
Iz temne straže bom prišel domov in pojedel prvi hlebec, ki ne bo vzhajal.

**Ana**  
Ko te bodo zvezde zadržale pozno, bom zate pustila pekarniško svetilko.
Vey je prebrala vsako ime v evidenci, ni našla nobenega manjkajočega in zaprla platnice.

**Vey**  
Dokončano pod obema urama. Preizkus se začne.

**Sefa**  
Tvoje.

**Tam**  
Tvoje.
Illuminara je stala med urama in čutila preprosto, zasebno veselje, takšno, ki nima namena in ga ne išče. Preizkus je ostajal zahtevno delo, Vey pa bo še naprej vodila njegovo evidenco.
Ko so se na vzhodu prižgale svetilke, sta medeninasti kazalec in črno kolo stala tam, kjer sta stala vso noč, ljudje pod njima pa so prvič brali oba.

translation_sl.critic_line: Illuminara dve polnoči, od katerih vsaka skriva skrb druge, spremeni v eno zavezo, evidenco z imenovanim človekom za vsako dolžnost in nevesto, ki nikoli ni meja; dve hiši pa se odpovesta pravici do otroka, da bi njuna ljubezen do nje ostala živa.
